theme: an old downtown back alley of a modern city on a moonless night, with an eerie urban ghost-story mood. It is a generic city that could be anywhere in the world: no country-specific or culture-specific architecture, objects, ornaments or symbols
objectStyle: The attached image is the ground of the game map, and these objects will be placed directly on it. thingStyle: These are things the player interacts with, so each one is a little lighter and slightly more colorful than the ground while still keeping the same muted night palette, and each has the soft glow described for it.
